I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`. The sandbox allows 5 requests per second, so one call every 0.25s stays under that with some margin. The interval is a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant at the top of the file. I didn't run the tests, since they call the live sandbox.

The loop makes 4 calls, so the sleeps add about 1s to the test. The sleep also runs after the last call, which isn't needed. I left it so the loop stays simple and the throttle applies if more amounts are added later.

I also saved the rate limit to EngramDB as a hazard, so future sessions know to throttle any new sandbox tests.
